papers.title_en: Towards Operational Conversational Intelligence: A Speech Intelligence Framework
papers.authors: C. Vishnoi, S. Khurana, A. Timmapur, S. Rai, S. Mohanty
papers.evidence: 提出融合说话人日志和语音识别的双路框架处理嘈杂穿戴相机音频，提升识别准确性
papers.tldr: 针对随身摄像机录音高噪声、多说话人重叠导致自动转录与说话人标注困难的问题，提出一种双路径对话智能框架。该框架先对原始音频预处理，再分为说话人日志分支（采用DeepFilterNet降噪、VAD和NVIDIA MSDD）和ASR分支（采用响度归一化和WhisperX大型v3模型进行强制对齐及概率引导分段），最后通过时间重叠分配实现词级说话人归属。在公开警察BWC数据集上的实验表明，任务特定声学处理和概率分段能有效改善日志、转录和说话人归属。该模块化架构为未来说话人感知对话系统奠定了基础。
papers.abstract_en: Body-worn camera (BWC) audio presents unique challenges including high ambient noise, variable recording conditions, and multiple overlapping speakers that make automated transcription and speaker labeling challenging. We propose a dual-path conversational intelligence framework that preprocesses raw BWC audio, separates the processing pipeline into a diarization branch and an ASR branch, and fuses their outputs. The diarization branch uses a denoising front-end (DeepFilterNet), voice activity detection (VAD), and NVIDIA's Multi-Scale Speaker Diarization Decoder (MSDD) with TitaNet embeddings. The transcription branch uses loudness normalization and WhisperX (Large-v3) with forced alignment and probability-guided speech segmentation. Finally, word-level speaker attribution is performed by assigning each recognized word to the speaker segment with the greatest temporal overlap. We evaluate the proposed framework on a curated body-worn camera dataset constructed from publicly available U.S. and U.K. police body-worn camera recordings. Experimental results demonstrate that task-specific acoustic conditioning and probability-guided speech segmentation improve speaker diarization, transcription, and word-level speaker attribution under challenging body-worn camera recording conditions. The proposed modular architecture provides an extensible foundation for future speaker-aware conversational intelligence systems.

papers.title_en: Extracting Voice Styles from Frozen TTS Models via Gradient-Based Inverse Optimization
papers.evidence: 基于梯度的逆优化从冻结TTS模型中提取音色向量，无需转录文本，提升声音克隆质量。
papers.tldr: 许多TTS系统发布时仅提供合成模型和预设风格向量，却未附带参考编码器，用户无法用自身录音生成风格向量来控制合成语音。本文通过梯度反向优化，固定所有模型权重，仅针对风格向量进行优化，使用来自单次录音的WavLM时间池化统计作为目标，无需文本对齐或转录。在154个说话人评估中，ECAPA-TDNN和ResNet相似度分别从0.132和0.099提升至0.413和0.401，验证器接受率由1%增至53%。该方法实现了从任意语音中提取风格，拓展了冻结TTS模型的个性化应用。
papers.abstract_en: Some text-to-speech systems ship a synthesis model and preset style vectors but not the reference encoder that turns audio into such a vector. The model still accepts a style vector; a user with a voice of their own cannot produce one. We solve for that input directly, inverting the released pipeline by gradient descent: every weight stays frozen and only the style vector is optimized, against time-pooled WavLM statistics of one recording. Because the objective discards the time axis, the synthesized text may differ from the recording, so no transcript and no alignment are needed. On 154 speakers from two corpora, ECAPA-TDNN similarity rises from 0.132 to 0.413 and ResNet from 0.099 to 0.401, improving for every speaker; a verifier at its equal-error point accepts 53% of the recovered voices as the target, against 1% for the presets they start from.

papers.title_en: SpeechLLM Meets Federated Learning for End-to-End ASR: English and Italian Case Studies
papers.authors: Mohamed Nabih Ali, Daniele Falavigna, Alessio Brutti
papers.evidence: 基于联邦学习的 SpeechLLM 端到端语音识别，在隐私保护下提升准确率
papers.tldr: 联邦学习用于分布式ASR可保护隐私，但SpeechLLM联邦训练仍空白。本文首次系统研究联邦SpeechLLM端到端ASR，提出通信高效优化策略以应对高维参数和梯度通信挑战。在英语和意大利语单语任务上，联邦训练达到竞争性词错误率，降低通信成本，并在多种声学条件下表现稳定。为多语言场景下的联邦语音大模型部署提供了实用基础。
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) enables privacy-preserving training of automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems across distributed data sources, yet its application to large-scale speech language models (SpeechLLMs) remains unexplored. This paper presents the first systematic study of federated training for SpeechLLM-based end-to-end ASR systems. We design a communication-efficient federated optimization strategy tailored to the unique challenges of SpeechLLM architectures, addressing high-dimensional parameter spaces, gradient communication overhead, and computational constraints in distributed settings. Through extensive empirical evaluation on monolingual ASR tasks in English and Italian, we demonstrate the effectiveness and stability of our federated approach compared to centralized training baselines across diverse acoustic conditions and speaking styles. Additionally, we conduct a comprehensive ablation study analyzing the impact of different speech encoder architectures on monolingual English ASR performance within the federated framework, providing insights into optimal model configurations for decentralized training. Our results achieve competitive word error rates while reducing communication costs, establishing practical foundations for federated SpeechLLM deployment in real-world multilingual scenarios.

papers.title_en: Evaluation of forced alignment of code-mixed speech: the case of Hindi-English
papers.authors: Ayushi Pandey, Pamir Gogoi, Kevin Tang
papers.evidence: 针对代码混合语音的强制对齐评估，是ASR/TTS数据预处理的关键步骤
papers.tldr: 代码混合语音的强制对齐面临音素集扩展、拼写非规范化和说话人变异等独特挑战，而双语对齐对语音识别与合成至关重要。本文以印地-英语为例，利用 Montreal Forced Aligner，针对本族/非本族音素自由变异与句中英语词边界检测难题，设计引导式词典策略。在句子级混合数据上训练声学模型后，边界对齐平均误差从单语模型的约38ms降至4.15ms，精度提升近十倍。该结果证实，词典优化与混合训练数据协同是实现高精度双语语音对齐的关键，为多语处理提供了有效方案。
papers.abstract_en: Code-mixed speech poses unique challenges to forced alignment: expanded inventories, orthographic errors, and speaker variation. We evaluate forced alignment of Hindi-English code-mixed speech using the Montreal Forced Aligner. We address 2 problems: (1) free variation involving native vs non-native pairs and (2) phonemic boundary detection for mid-utterance English words. Bootstrapping strategies substantially outperform unmodified lexicons. Acoustic models trained on sentence-level code-mixed data achieve a mean error of 4.15ms, ie. ten times lower than monolingual Hindi (38.18ms) or isolated English (37.58ms) alternatives. Principled lexicon design and code-mixed training data are both essential for reliable alignment of bilingual speech.

papers.title_en: Omni-Prune: Query-Aware Unified Token Pruning for Efficient Omnimodal Large Language Models
papers.authors: Yiming Zhong, Chang Nie, Caifeng Shan
papers.evidence: 针对视听输入的全模态大语言模型的token剪枝框架提升推理效率，有助于视觉-语音多模态学习。
papers.tldr: 现有全模态大模型处理长音视频序列时推理效率低下，且现有剪枝方法忽视跨模态关联与用户查询重要性。Omni-Prune提出一种免训练、查询感知的音视频联合剪枝框架，通过自适应时间窗口、注意力与查询相关性联合评分及K-medoids代表性选择，大幅降低冗余。实验表明，该框架实现3.25倍加速和1.3倍内存节省，同时保持99%以上模型性能，为高效全模态推理提供了实用方案。
papers.abstract_en: Omnimodal large language models (OmniLLMs) are rapidly extending multimodal reasoning to cover synchronized audio and video. However, the resulting audio-video token sequences are long, leading to high prefill latency and GPU memory usage at inference time. Existing token pruning methods, designed mainly for vision-only inputs, miss both the cross-modal links between audio and video and the user query that decides which content matters. To bridge this gap, we present Omni-Prune, a training-free, query-aware audio-visual token pruning framework that jointly removes redundancy from both modalities while keeping task-relevant cross-modal evidence. Specifically, Omni-Prune first splits the token sequence into adaptive time windows placed at audio saliency peaks, then scores audio and video tokens on a single scale that combines encoder attention with text-query relevance, and pairs related audio-video tokens so that they are kept together. Within each window, a final K-medoids step then selects a few representative tokens, adding diverse cues that score-based selection alone would miss. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Omni-Prune outperforms established baseline methods, delivering up to 3.25x prefill speedup and 1.3x memory reduction while retaining over 99% of full-model performance.

papers.title_en: VAD to the Bone: Ultra-Tiny Speech Activity Detection for Edge Deployment
papers.authors: Stephen Bauer, Sheila Seidel, Shanza Iftikhar, Scott Veidenheimer, Gorkem Ulkar
papers.evidence: 语音活动检测是语音模型预处理的关键步骤，实现了高效的边缘部署。
papers.tldr: 语音活动检测（VAD）在常开系统中触发下游处理，但面临严格的内存、延迟与算力限制。现有紧凑模型虽准确性高，却依赖可学习滤波器组、循环层或非因果后处理等未获广泛硬件支持的组件。为此我们设计kiloVAD，采用标准梅尔特征与纯CNN层，并通过逐层结构化剪枝、自蒸馏和角度度量量化感知训练进行极致压缩。在因果逐帧评估下，kiloVAD仅凭2.1k参数与200ms上下文即在AVA-Speech上取得0.850 AUC，刷新因果可部署VAD的最佳性能。该工作为资源极度受限的嵌入式语音接口提供了可行方案。
papers.abstract_en: Voice activity detection (VAD) triggers downstream speech processing in always-on systems under strict memory, latency, and compute constraints. Recent compact models report strong accuracy but rely on components that are not widely supported: learnable filterbanks, recurrent layers, or non-causal post-processing. We propose kiloVAD, designed for embedded inference using standard Mel features, CNN-only layers, and tunable context/spectral parameters. We introduce per-layer structured pruning with self-distillation and angle-based quantization-aware training (QAT) that outperforms standard QAT by 1-4%. Evaluated per-frame under causal conditions, kiloVAD achieves 0.850 AUC on AVA-Speech with 2.1 k parameters and 200 ms context, establishing a new state of the art for causal, deployment-ready VAD.

papers.title_en: What the Waveform Knows: Transparent-first Speech and Audio Intelligence with Caption Studio
papers.authors: Cheng Siong Chin, Jianhua Zhang, Mohan Venkateshkumar
papers.evidence: 基于自动语音识别的语音转录和分析平台，赋能语音交互应用。
papers.tldr: 语音智能系统在会议记录、媒体制作等场景应用广泛，但多数工具提供黑盒指标，缺乏可解释性，难以满足审计与合规要求。Caption Studio提出透明性优先的语音分析平台，集成Whisper ASR与pyannote说话人分离，构建三层架构：核心转录与分离层、音频智能层（从波形、频谱、基频等提取特征）和整合层。核心创新在于所有分析指标均标注来源（实测、推导或不可用），确保可追溯性与可解释性。系统通过FastAPI后端与实时仪表盘，支持自动化转录、字幕生成和特征分析，并在基准测试中验证了有效性，为企业级可靠部署提供了参考。
papers.abstract_en: Caption Studio is a transparency-first speech and audio intelligence platform that transforms spoken audio and video into structured, searchable content through automated transcription, speaker diarization, speech analytics, signal-level audio analysis, and subtitle generation. The system is built on a FastAPI backend with a real-time dashboard and adopts a three-layer architecture comprising (i) a transcription and diarization core based on Whisper-class automatic speech recognition and pyannote speaker diarization, (ii) an audio intelligence layer that extracts acoustic and linguistic features, including waveforms, spectrograms, pitch, speaking rate, silence, filler-word frequency, and sentiment, directly from the audio signal, and (iii) an integration layer that supports data export and downstream workflow integration. A principal contribution of this work is the transparency-first framework, in which every reported metric is explicitly identified as measured, derived, or unavailable, thereby improving the traceability, interpretability, and reliability of speech analytics. The paper presents the system architecture, benchmarking methodology, explainability and uncertainty framework, and key considerations for enterprise-scale deployment.

papers.title_en: OmniDelta: Skill-Driven Budget Allocation for Token Compression in OmniLLMs
papers.authors: Haoyang Huang, Wenjie Huang, Tianqi Xu, Hongyaoxing Gu, Kang Tan, Yikai Fu, Yuhao Shen, Tianyu Liu, Baolin Zhang, Jun Zhang, Xinyi Hu, Jun Dai, Shuang Ge, Lei Chen, Yue Li, Mingchen Wang, Meng Zhang
papers.evidence: 全模态大模型中的音视频令牌压缩以高效多模态理解
papers.tldr: 全模态大语言模型（OmniLLMs）统一处理文本、音频与视频，但其长 token 序列导致高显存和推理延迟。现有 token 压缩方法多在固定预算下选择重要 token，而前序预算分配问题未得到探索，跨模态直接相似度分配不可靠，均匀模态内预算易忽略关键信息或保留冗余。为此，提出 OmniDelta，一个免训练、技能驱动的 token 压缩框架。它先构建音视频技能池，依据查询意图动态调整跨模态预算，再基于局部内容复杂度和时序冗余在片段间重分配预算，使总保留率不变但预算更精准，且能与现有剪枝方法无缝结合。在四个音视频基准和两个 Qwen2.5-Omni 模型上的实验表明，OmniDelta 在精度-效率权衡上建立了新的 Pareto 前沿：25% token 保留时，GPU 内存降低 22.0%，端到端加速达 1.64 倍，验证了技能驱动动态分配的有效性。
papers.abstract_en: Emerging Omni-modal Large Language Models (OmniLLMs) enable unified understanding of text, audio, and video, but their long audio-video token sequences introduce substantial memory and inference costs. Existing compression methods mainly focus on selecting important tokens under fixed budgets, leaving the preceding budget-allocation problem underexplored. We show that direct query-to-audio/video similarity is unreliable for inter-modal budget allocation, and that uniform intra-modal budgets can miss key evidence while retaining redundant content. To address these limitations, we propose OmniDelta, a training-free, skill-driven framework that couples intent-aware inter-modal allocation with content-aware intra-modal allocation. OmniDelta first constructs audio and video skill pools to shift the fixed retained-token budget according to query demand, then reallocates modality budgets over audio segments and video frames using local complexity and temporal redundancy. The resulting local budgets can be combined with existing pruning strategies, preserving the total retained-token ratio while changing where the budget is spent. Experiments on four audio-video benchmarks with two Qwen2.5-Omni models show that OmniDelta establishes a new accuracy-efficiency Pareto frontier across pruning ratios. At 25% token retention on Qwen2.5-Omni-7B, OmniDelta reduces GPU memory by 22.0% and achieves a 1.64x end-to-end speedup over full-token inference.
